name: Kindred [SnowBound]
source:
A peaceful morning stroll has turned into the deadliest day of your life. 

Play as a young woman living in a bucolic, peaceful Slavic village who is thrust into an apocalyptic scenario: a doomsday attack on her home. Running seems to be the only survivable option.
The dark depths of the nearby woods hide an even darker secret. An encounter with a mysterious beast of a man in the woods leaves you in a heart-racing predicament. 

Will you find a way to escape him?

Or will you learn how to dig deeper, and earn the man's trust instead? 

Choose a side; Don't look back.

This rabbit hole goes deeper than you think. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3398950/Kindred_SnowBound/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
平静的早晨散步变成了你一生中最致命的一天。

扮演一名生活在田园风光、和平的斯拉夫村庄的年轻女子，她被推入世界末日的场景：她的家遭到末日袭击。跑步似乎是唯一的生存选择。
附近树林的黑暗深处隐藏着一个更黑暗的秘密。在树林里遇到神秘野兽的人让你陷入了心跳加速的困境。

你会找到逃离他的方法吗？

或者你会学习如何深入挖掘并赢得男人的信任？

选择一方；别回头。

这个兔子洞比你想象的还要深。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3398950/Kindred_SnowBound/]Steam[/url]]
